reuse.why: Threads the flag through the existing getBudgetActionCategories for setZero, setLastMonthSpending and the average actions, but copyPreviousMonth keeps its own inline hidden check instead of using the shared selection.

duplication.why: The flag-gated hidden rule is now written twice, once as SQL `? OR (c.hidden = 0 AND ...)` in getBudgetActionCategories and once as `!includeHiddenCategories && (hidden || group_hidden)` in copyPreviousMonth.

placement.why: The variation is a parameter of the shared category selection in budget/actions.ts, which is the right layer; only copyPreviousMonth decides it elsewhere.

scope.why: Most of the test diff is prettier reformatting of pre-existing tests unrelated to the feature.

maintainability.why: A single boolean parameter is reasonable, but the hidden rule still lives in two shapes, so the next rule change must again be made in both.

bypasses_abstraction.where: copyPreviousMonth (actions.ts) applies the new includeHiddenCategories rule inline over getBudgetData rows instead of through getBudgetActionCategories.

disguised_duplication.where: The same flag-gated hidden/group-hidden rule appears as a SQL predicate in getBudgetActionCategories and as a TS condition in copyPreviousMonth.
